SummaryOfPosition.Summary: The Appellants seek declaratory and injunctive relief regarding the boundary between their property and the Respondent's, contending that the Respondent has encroached upon their land by approximately 2.4 metres along a 45-metre boundary.

FactsReliedOn.item: The Appellants purchased their property, Meadow View, in 2008.
In 2022, the Appellants commissioned a survey which revealed that the Respondent's fence encroaches 2.4 metres onto their title.
Historical aerial photographs from 1985 show the original boundary line corresponding to the Appellants' title plan.
The Respondent erected the current fence in 2005 without the Appellants' predecessors' consent.
The encroachment includes part of the Appellants' garden and a mature oak tree.

The Respondent has not applied to Land Registry as required by Schedule 6 LRA 2002.
